data.long_meaning: Anulata means 'desire' or 'attraction'. It is derived from the Sanskrit root word 'anu' which means 'towards' and 'lata' which means 'that which is drawn towards'. In Hindu mythology, Anulata represents the deep-rooted emotions and longings of the heart.
